title: ECoG_Tonal_Speech_Perception
description: Electrocorticography (ECoG) recordings from patients undergoing surgery at Huashan Hospital while they perceived speech in a tonal language (Mandarin). This derivative release provides the high-gamma amplitude envelope (70-150 Hz Hilbert transform) rather than raw voltage, converted from NWB to EDF in a BIDS-compliant structure. It supports study of the fine-grained spatiotemporal neural dynamics of tonal speech perception.
methods_description: Intracranial ECoG was recorded during a speech perception task, with participants giving written informed consent the day before surgery. The authors' 70-150 Hz Hilbert high-gamma envelope, originally stored in NWB, was exported to EDF (in uV) with round-trip conversion error reported per file.
